verdict.rationale: Cline's docs show clear support for running tests/dev servers live, linter-aware multi-file fixes, and general terminal/file automation (cline-docs-14, cline-docs-30, cline-docs-4), and community reviews praise its overall coding effectiveness (cline-comm-1, cline-comm-3). However there's no explicit documentation of merge-conflict resolution or dependency-update workflows specifically. missing for 10: explicit examples/docs of resolving merge conflicts, explicit dependency-update workflows, independent hands-on proof of lint-fixing accuracy beyond vendor claims.
